Sunday, September 13, 2026 Daily Digest

CMO Tenure Rises as 88% Adopt AI, Miro Sells at 2.2x Revenue, IDC Signals AI Accountability Era

Today's top stories in AI + enterprise tech

1

CMO Tenure Ticks Up to 4.3 Years as 88% of B2B Orgs Adopt AI

Two data points that tell a story together: Spencer Stuart reports Fortune 500 CMO tenure rose to 4.3 years in 2024, up from 4.2 — with 65% of departing CMOs moving to equal or better roles. Meanwhile, Forrester's August 2026 data shows 88% of B2B marketing organizations have adopted AI tools. But here's the catch: leaders still cite unresolved gaps in strategy and measurement. AI is everywhere. Understanding how to use it isn't.

2

Miro Sells to Bending Spoons for $1.355B — A SaaS Valuation Reality Check

The digital whiteboard company that raised at a reported $17.5B valuation in 2022 is selling to Italy's Bending Spoons for $1.355B in all-cash. Miro has 250,000+ organizations and about $600M ARR — putting this at roughly 2.2x revenue. For SaaS founders, the lesson is stark: funding-era valuations don't guarantee exits. Buyers pay for retention, margin, and durable cash flow — not hype.

Read on Mean CEO →
3

IDC's New CMO Hire Signals the AI Accountability Era for Agencies

When an analyst firm hires a CMO, it's not just personnel news — it's a signal of what enterprise buyers will expect next. IDC's new hire brings a résumé heavy on demand generation, brand strategy, and AI governance, not pure AI specialization. Translation: the market wants marketing operators who can layer AI fluency onto fundamentals, not AI-first hires with thin brand experience. Agencies take note.

Read on Influencers Time →
4

Box Ships ChatGPT Connector — But Who Owns the Permission Tree?

Box announced users can now browse folders, preview files, and run MCP actions against Box content from inside ChatGPT, with Box permissions carried through. Sounds clean. But as Agile Brand Guide points out: a permission model built for humans browsing a web app becomes the control surface for an AI that reads everything it can reach. A folder your colleague would never open — but technically could — is now retrievable context. Governance just got real.

Read on Agile Brand Guide →
5

OpenAI and Meta Push Deeper Into Marketing Tools

OpenAI launched ChatGPT Work and ChatGPT Ads, connecting to HubSpot, Salesforce, and Adobe through plugins. Meta continues expanding Advantage+ and Andromeda, though Marketing Brew reports full automation "may still be years away." The pattern: AI giants are building marketing infrastructure, not just chat interfaces. The question for CMOs: will your stack integrate with theirs, or compete against it?

Read on MarketScale →

💡 My Take

Governance is the new growth lever. Every story today points the same direction: AI adoption hit saturation, but AI mastery remains rare. Miro's valuation haircut shows markets reward durability over hype. IDC's CMO hire shows enterprises want operators, not evangelists. Box's ChatGPT connector shows that permission models built for humans don't translate to AI. The leaders who figure out AI governance — not just AI deployment — will define the next era.
